responsibility: Defines RTL machine-description patterns for the RISC-V vector cryptography extensions. It introduces the UNSPEC codes, iterators, and predicated instruction patterns for vector bit-reversal and carryless-multiply helpers, AES round/key-schedule instructions, SHA-2 operations, GHASH/GMUL, and SM3/SM4 operations, thereby supplying the backend instruction-selection layer for Zvk* and related RVV crypto opcodes beyond the scalar crypto support in crypto.md.
